about_short_description.short_description: AI Insurance is an insurance management platform that uses AI to automate specialty and commercial programs

product.name: Submissions Parsing
product.description: An AI-driven tool that reads email submissions, extracts data from attached files, and automatically builds insurance quotes.

product.name: Bill Review
product.description: An AI service that reads and audits invoices from defense counsel against predefined guidelines to prevent unauthorized legal fee payments.

product.name: Bordereaux Parsing
product.description: An AI-powered solution that extracts, validates, and imports policy and claims data from bordereaux reports into insurance systems.

product.name: Claims Parsing
product.description: An AI tool that reads and extracts data from claim documents, automating data entry to expedite claims handling.

product.name: Underwriting Workbench
product.description: A platform feature that calculates premiums based on custom rules to quickly generate quotes and issue policies.

product.name: Policy Issuance and Signing
product.description: A feature that enables creation of policies, generation of quotes, and collection of signatures with a single click.
